failures.name: CavesOfOoo.Tests.RegionalSituationOutcomeTests.BeatingRecoveryRecordsRealFilterStockWithoutInventingBankOutcome
failures.message:
Completed receipt must not advertise an outstanding request.
  Expected: not String containing "Recover the marked"
  But was:  "The lost filter-sand consignment [completed]. Source (8,17); return to merchant in Wellmeet (8,16). Recover the marked sealed consignment intact; ordinary loose goods do not replace it. Height exposure parches bare heads; headgear or actual interior shelter protects you. Payment: 12 drams and one fire clay. Read, deliver, or release through the recipient's [C] actions."
